papers.deep_takeaway: Contributes an automatically mined, executable repository-level Java benchmark of 1,099 pure developer refactorings (922 atomic, 177 compound) across 18 OSS projects via RefactoringMiner + PurityChecker, Eclipse JDT cross-file context, multi-JDK builds, and JaCoCo coverage filtering. Evaluating 9 LLMs, RRF RAG, a 2-agent Developer/Reviewer workflow (52.68% with gpt-4o-mini), and GPT-5.1-Codex exposes a steep compound-refactoring cliff (82.6% atomic vs 39.4% compound) and empty-method test-overfitting cheats caught only by AST Refactoring Verification. Supplies Evo with a multi-project Java benchmark blueprint, motivates deterministic compound OpenRewrite recipes in JavaRepairRecipes, and establishes AST transformation purity gating alongside sandbox test execution.

papers.deep_takeaway: Bridges the APR causality gap via a minimal causal context built by dual-slicing — context-aware SDG static slicing with inter-procedural helper/field resolution on failing tests plus Slicer4J dynamic slicing reconstructed into an AST Skeleton Tree with file, Javadoc, and line anchors — paired with an m=5, n=3 conversational loop and 10-variant Patch Augmentation. Under unified DeepSeek-V3 (25-patch budget), CausalRepair fixes 313/365 Defects4J (+32.6% over ReinFix, 85.8% plausible precision), 289/324 Defects4J-Trans (+44.5%), 101/199 GitBug-Java, and 232 SBFL bugs at $0.029 and 23.28 min/bug (removing test or dynamic slicing drops fixes -38.3% and -26.5%). Provides Evo's blueprint to upgrade JavaMethodSlicer and RepairContextPlanner, ground SKG-RTS (AffectedTestSelector) with sandboxed dynamic traces, and replace manual plausible-patch selection with automated Spring-SAT and behavioral ranking.
